summary: Mr. Arking discusses the varying customs regarding the recitation of a special haftarah on Shabbat HaGadol. He reviews the practices of different communities and rabbis, specifically focusing on whether the haftarah is read annually, only when erev Pesach falls on Shabbat, or not at all.
questions: Is there a special haftarah for Shabbat HaGadol?
Did Maran mention a special haftarah for Shabbat HaGadol in the Shulchan Aruch?
What was the custom in Aleppo regarding the Shabbat HaGadol haftarah?
Did the custom of reading a special haftarah vary based on when erev Pesach falls?
What did Chacham David Tawil say about the custom in Brooklyn?
